case: P04/E02 OpenAI × Chat Completions failure and truncation terminals
source: Synthetic offline fixture. Chunk shapes follow OpenAI's streamed Chat Completions (stream_options.include_usage) as consumed by pi-ai 0.87.1 (commit 898ab804050730e9dcefb4443875d5a932aa6a32) packages/ai/src/api/openai-completions.ts through openai-node 6.40.0 (Stream.fromSSEResponse). Expected requests follow pi's buildParams and convertMessages for the standard OpenAI compat; the models are pi's OpenAI data on the openai-completions API (ADR-0013). Costs are pi's calculateCost at the frozen prices of the model used.

scenarios.about: The stream ends ([DONE] and EOF) without a finish_reason: the open block still ends, then the call fails; text and usage are kept.
A finish_reason is the terminal: a body that ends without data: [DONE] after it still succeeds.
An error finish_reason is recorded and fails the call once the stream ended, after the open block ended; the usage stays.
A finish_reason pi does not know is an error too, reported with the provider's word.
length is a successful truncation terminal.
A tool call cut off by length stays length, never toolUse, and its arguments are incomplete, so the host does not execute it.
A data event that is not one JSON document fails the stream; the open block never ends.

expect.errorMessage: OpenAI Chat Completions stream event is not valid JSON

scenarios.about: A chunk with an error object after the stream started: openai-node's APIError message, the open block never ends.

error.message: The server had an error while processing your request.

expect.errorMessage: The server had an error while processing your request.

scenarios.about: An in-band error echoing the call's key: the message keeps the text but not the key (a recorded security difference).
OpenRouter's upstream provider error in metadata.raw follows the message on its own line.
An error field that is null is not an error: the chunk is read as usual.
Chunks that are not objects, or have no choices, carry nothing pi reads; the stream goes on.
A JSON error object the SDK's message does not quote is shown as '<status>: <object>'; a 400 is not retried.
A provider echoing a masked key: the message keeps the body but not the key (a recorded security difference).

replies.body: {"error":{"message":"Incorrect API key provided: sk-test-****0001. You can find your API key at https://platform.openai.com/account/api-keys.","type":"invalid_request_error","param":null,"code":"invalid_api_key"}}

expect.errorMessage: 401: {"message":"Incorrect API key provided: [REDACTED]. You can find your API key at https://platform.openai.com/account/api-keys.","type":"invalid_request_error","param":null,"code":"invalid_api_key"}

scenarios.about: A body that is not JSON is the SDK's '<status> <text>'.

Maintainer approved 2026-10-08: sync OpenAI Node SDK 7.19.0 / pi 1.0.0. Previously error-less HTTP objects lost their body; SDK now wraps missing/null error, and named SSE event:error now throws APIError(data.error ?? data) before the adapter.
OpenRouter's raw upstream error follows an HTTP error's message.
The connection drops mid-stream: what arrived is kept and the call fails without ending the block.

expect.errorMessage: Connection lost while reading the OpenAI Chat Completions stream

scenarios.about: A cut stream still keeps the streamed reasoning_details as the thinking block's signature, without an end event.

expect.errorMessage: Connection lost while reading the OpenAI Chat Completions stream

scenarios.about: The caller cancels while the provider holds the stream open: openai-node ends the stream quietly, the open block ends, then the call is aborted.
The connection drops before any response: the SDK's connection error.
